Name: Sentinel HUD
Author: MTitan
Punchline: Modular, configurable awareness enhancements for the FFXIV HUD.
Description: Adds configurable actor panels, PvP targeting-me awareness, HP/MP/shield/cast bars, native actor interactions, exact-position awareness, optional encounter danger providers, and extended camera zoom. Anti-AFK and Quest Convenience settings are available in Sentinel Hub.
